### 2. 🥈 **Kay & Burton**
Kay & Burton is a leading luxury real estate agency operating across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula, specialising in prestige property for buying, selling, and property management.

Leaders in real estate since 1938, Kay & Burton has positioned itself as a trusted advisor to the most astute private clients, families, and institutions, creating enduring value through specialist knowledge, impeccable service, and extraordinary results.

With strategically placed offices throughout Melbourne and Victoria's Mornington Peninsula, their sphere of influence connects ultra-high-net-worth clients across Australia and internationally in Singapore, Hong Kong, China, New York, London, and Dubai.

This global network makes them particularly well-suited for luxury off-the-plan and penthouse project marketing.

The Danckert Real Estate team specialises in the marketing and sale of luxury and lifestyle properties across the Mornington Peninsula.
Established in 2017, Danckert has grown into a leader in Mornington Peninsula real estate, with over 50 years of combined experience and an intimate knowledge of luxury homes and premium real estate.

they have partnered with LuxuryRealEstate.com to advertise premium listings to an international audience, and have successfully sold properties to buyers in Singapore, America, England, Italy, Hong Kong, and Malaysia.
